## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I have personally reviewed and tested this code and PR description. It is not an unattended agent-generated submission.
- [ ] For a new feature or behavior change, this PR links an issue labeled `accepted`. Bug, test, and doc fixes are exempt.
- [ ] I have considered HTTP and STDIO parity for any MCP-facing change.
- [ ] I updated relevant tests and documentation, or explained why neither is needed.
